name: Wojciech Krupa
headline: Software Engineer — .NET, WPF, robotics
summary: Software engineer at Bee Robotics who builds WPF interfaces and control routines for robotic systems. Background in .NET through EPAM's training and internship programme, plus full-stack web projects.
about: B.Eng. in Aeronautics and Space Technology (aircraft engines), and a music teacher certified by Yamaha Music Europe. I bring an engineer's rigour and a musician's ear for detail to software.
